name: Temple Satrams & Dharamshalas
distance: Within the Srisailam temple complex and gateway precincts (~1.1 km)
description: Rest houses, Satrams, and Dharamshalas established for pilgrim lodging, dating back to historic royal grants such as the 1069 C.E. Kalyana Chalukya grant. Includes community-run facilities offering basic amenities.

name: AP Tourism Haritha Hotel
description: A well-maintained government property located within walking distance of the shrine. Features standard air-conditioned deluxe rooms and an on-site pure vegetarian dining hall.

name: Hotel Srisailas Nest
description: A popular private establishment offering modern amenities, clean air-conditioned family suites, geysers, 24/7 room service, and an attached vegetarian restaurant.

name: Hilltop Mrugavani Resort
distance: 22 km from the temple (Located in Eegalapenta)
description: A premium luxury resort option on the Telangana side of the forest checkpoint. Offers independent cottages, scenic views of the Krishna River valley, and an outdoor swimming pool.
